::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/metadata_key_rules"}
#docs
While the business's metadata_validation is on, every later write of that entity's `metadata` is checked against its rules. Stored records are not changed.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of record the rule applies to. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `key` | `string` | **yes** | A dot path into metadata: 1 to 5 levels, each 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. Cannot change after create. A rule below another rule needs that rule to be an object. Every path is optional: a rule checks a value only when it is present and not null. |
| `data_type` | `string` | **yes** | Checked as given; values are never converted. `object` asserts a JSON object, `array` a JSON array (items are checked only when item_type or item_enum_options is set). One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`, `email`, `enum`, `object`, `array`. |
| `enum_options` | `array of string` | no | Necessary when data_type is enum |
| `pattern` | `string` | no | Regular expression the whole value must match. Text types only. |
| `max_length` | `integer` | no | Text types only |
| `integer` | `boolean` | no | Number type only. The value must be a whole number. |
| `min` | `number` | no | Number type only. The lowest permitted value, inclusive. |
| `max` | `number` | no | Number type only. The highest permitted value, inclusive. Not less than min. |
| `item_type` | `string` | no | Array type only. The type each item must have. One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`. |
| `item_enum_options` | `array of string` | no | Array type only. The values each item can have. Needs item_type string; on create, item_type defaults to string when this is set. |
| `min_items` | `integer` | no | Array type only. The fewest items, inclusive. |
| `max_items` | `integer` | no | Array type only. The most items, inclusive. Not less than min_items. |
| `description` | `string` | no | A description of the rule. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The metadata key rule's id (mkr_…). |
| `entity_type` | `string` | The kind of record the rule applies to. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `key` | `string` | The metadata key the rule applies to. |
| `data_type` | `string` | The type the key's value must have. |
| `enum_options` | `array of string` | The allowed values, for an `enum` key. |
| `pattern` | `string` | A regular expression the value must match. |
| `max_length` | `integer` | The longest allowed string. |
| `integer` | `boolean` | True if a number must be a whole number. |
| `min` | `number` | The smallest allowed number. |
| `max` | `number` | The largest allowed number. |
| `item_type` | `string` | The type of each item, for an array key. One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`. |
| `item_enum_options` | `array of string` | The allowed values of each item, for an array key. |
| `min_items` | `integer` | The fewest items allowed, for an array key. |
| `max_items` | `integer` | The most items allowed, for an array key. |
| `description` | `string` | A description of the rule. |
| `archived` | `boolean` | True if the rule is archived. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the metadata key rule was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the metadata key rule was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. Send it as `expected_version` on update. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid rule; `param` names the field |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/metadata_key_rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "entity_type": "customer",
    "key": "billing.po",
    "data_type": "string",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs."
  }'
```
